summary: __thiscall scene-state creation. Bails out (returns 0) unless the guard flag at this+0x13D8 is non-zero. Builds a 26-dword parameter block on the stack, memset to zero, then fills it according to mode a2 (a2 == 1 sets indices 0 and 19 to type-specific values; a2 == 2 or 4 set index 0 to 1 and index 19 to the float square root of the FLT_MAX double constant). Defaults fill identity-like float bit patterns into several slots. Calls the object at this+0x1100 through vtable slot 176 (offset 0xB0) with (this+0x1100 object, this[1261], params) and stores the result into this[0]. Returns -1 on failure; on success increments the counter this+0x13B4 and returns its previous value.

operations.description: Guard on this[1270] (this+0x13D8) being non-zero; otherwise return 0 immediately.
Zero the 26-dword stack parameter block v7 with memset(v7, 0, sizeof(v7)).
Mode a2 == 2 or a2 == 4: set v7[0] = 1 and the float at v7[19] = sqrt(3.402823466385289e38), the square root of the FLT_MAX double constant.
Load v4 = this[1261] (this+0x13B4) and v5 = this[1088] (this+0x1100).

Default-initialize parameter slots with the numeric literals 1065353216 (v7[1], v7[2], v7[3], v7[5], v7[6], v7[7], v7[21]), -1082130432 (v7[17]) and 0 (v7[22], v7[23]); the literals are left as-is without decoding.
Indirect __stdcall call through vtable slot 176 (*(*v5 + 0xB0)) on the object at this+0x1100, passing (v5, v4, v7), and store the returned handle into *this (this+0x0).
Guard on the creation result v6; if non-zero (failure), return -1.
Increment the scene-state counter: this[1261] (this+0x13B4) = result + 1, keeping the prior value as the return value.
Return the previous counter value on success, -1 on creation failure, or 0 when the guard flag is clear.
Called by StringCopyWithFlagUnion (0x0055D2A0) to create a scene state object.
